<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916723_theRebbe_111" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916723_theRebbe_111__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that despite the apparent changes in the light through the chain of descent, there is no change in the light itself, and through contemplation of "I am Hashem, I have not changed," one develops two desires: for all spiritual powers to be in G‑dliness, and to be sustained directly from the Essence.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, regarding the matter of "I am Hashem, I have not changed," the Rebbe [the Rebbe Rashab]</t>
    <t s="2">(the Rebbe [the Rebbe Rashab])</t>
    <t s="3">of blessed memory explains,</t>
    <t s="4">that superficially, this is difficult, for there is a chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="5">and the light changes from world to world and is contracted according to the capacity of each world, until in this world the light is most contracted and is in concealment and hiding to the utmost, which is why it is called "lower," as there is none lower than it in level,</t>
    <t s="6">and this is a change in the light.</t>
    <t s="7">And he explains there,</t>
    <t s="8">that nevertheless, this is not a change from the perspective of the lights,</t>
    <t s="9">for although there are several distinctions in the light, in that the light as it is in Asiyah is not like it is in Yetzirah,</t>
    <t s="10">and in Yetzirah it is not like it is in Beriyah, and in Beriyah it is not like it is in Atzilus, and so on higher,</t>
    <t s="11">these distinctions are only from the perspective of the worlds,</t>
    <t s="12">in that the world is not a vessel to receive a more elevated light,</t>
    <t s="13">but the light itself exists in its perfection and fullness below as it does above.</t>
    <t s="14">However, it is still not understood, for this very fact that the worlds cannot receive it is a change,</t>
    <t s="15">and he explains regarding this that even the change that comes from the worlds and the recipients is not a change,</t>
    <t s="16">for that the recipients cannot receive the light is from the side of the shield that exists upon Hashem, which is the concealment of the Name Elokim,</t>
    <t s="17">and the Name Elokim is a holy name from the seven names that are not erased,</t>
    <t s="18">and therefore, relative to the light itself, this is no concealment at all, for an essence does not conceal an essence, as is known,</t>
    <t s="19">meaning that even from the perspective of the concealments and hiding places, there is no change in the light at all.</t>
    <t s="20">Yet it still needs to be understood, for superficially there is a change in the light from the perspective of the creations,</t>
    <t s="21">for the creations are distinct from one another,</t>
    <t s="22">and the coming into being of the creations is from the aspect of the light of the word of Hashem,</t>
    <t s="23">in that each creation has a distinct utterance separate from another,</t>
    <t s="24">and if so, this is a change in the light.</t>
    <t s="25">And he explains regarding this that in truth, even this is not a change.</t>
    <t s="26">And he explains based on the analogy of the light of the sun explained in Tanya,</t>
    <t s="27">that specifically when the light goes out from the luminary, it exists as light,</t>
    <t s="28">but when it is within the luminary, it has no existence at all, for it is utterly nullified in existence within the luminary.</t>
    <t s="29">Therefore, the word of Hashem that constantly brings the creations into being and is the entire essence of their existence,</t>
    <t s="30">and as is known,</t>
    <t s="31">this is not comparable to when something goes out from a craftsman to a vessel, for the vessel can endure without the craftsman because it is something from something, and the craftsman did not create the existence of the entity, unlike in the bringing into being of something from nothing and absolute naught, for the light must constantly bring the creations into being and is the entire essence of their existence,</t>
    <t s="32">and the light is always found within the Luminary,</t>
    <t s="33">for within the Luminary, the matter of contraction and removal, heaven forbid, does not apply,</t>
    <t s="34">and He is found in every place,</t>
    <t s="35">even in the place where the creation and the utterance that brings it into being, sustains it, and enlivens it exist,</t>
    <t s="36">and since the creations and the light that brings them into being are always found within the Luminary, they are nullified utterly, like the nullification of the ray of the sun within the sun,</t>
    <t s="37">and if so, it is understood that even from the perspective of the existence of the creation, there is no change at all.</t>
    <t s="38">And through contemplation on the matter of "I am Hashem, I have not changed," there is aroused in him a desire for two matters,</t>
    <t s="39">in spirituality and in physicality.</t>
    <t s="40">The first matter is that when he contemplates that the entire order of the chain of descent does not cause any change at all,</t>
    <t s="41">therefore he will desire that all his powers and desires be only in G‑dliness.</t>
    <t s="42">And the second matter is that when he contemplates that "I am Hashem, I have not changed" and everything is found within the Essence,</t>
    <t s="43">therefore he will desire that even in the existence of the creation, he will not need to be sustained from matters in whose externality G‑dliness is not apparent,</t>
    <t s="44">but rather that he be sustained from the Essence,</t>
    <t s="45">sustained from the radiance of the Shechinah.</t>
    <t s="46">And the difference between these two matters is,</t>
    <t s="47">that the first matter, that all his spiritual powers, and in general the inner powers, will, and delight, be only in G‑dliness,</t>
    <t s="48">this matter is within the power of the person,</t>
    <t s="49">and this is the service that is demanded of him,</t>
    <t s="50">for this is the matter of the service of the offerings, to offer the blood and the fat,</t>
    <t s="51">that the blood is the soul,</t>
    <t s="52">meaning the vitality,</t>
    <t s="53">and the fat is the delight, the "cooking and flavor,"</t>
    <t s="54">to offer them upon the altar to Hashem, that they be only in G‑dliness.</t>
    <t s="55">And this matter can be effected not only in the time when the Holy Temple existed, but also in this generation, and specifically from within the distress,</t>
    <t s="56">that what he must toil to overcome the double and multiple darkness,</t>
    <t s="57">through this specifically he can reach a higher level,</t>
    <t s="58">which is from the side of the power of self-sacrifice that exists now more than in the time of the Temple,</t>
    <t s="59">However, the second matter, that he will not need to be sustained from matters in whose externality there is no G‑dliness, but rather that he be sustained from the radiance of the Shechinah,</t>
    <t s="60">this will be when He will remove the spirit of impurity from the earth,</t>
    <t s="61">and it is the revelation of the future, of which it is said, "And it shall be said on that day, Behold, this is our G‑d,"</t>
    <t s="62">that there will be a tangible revelation of G‑dliness,</t>
    <t s="63">that there will be a revelation of the power of the Actor within the acted-upon,</t>
    <t s="64">and it will be felt that "there is nothing besides Him."</t>
    <t s="65">And this is the matter of "I am Hashem, I have not changed,"</t>
    <t s="66">that although He is at every time and in every moment and in every place,</t>
    <t s="67">nevertheless, in order for there to be a tangible revelation in all his matters,</t>
    <t s="68">this will be revealed specifically in the future, through the service now in the spiritual service, which is the service of the boards and the fulfillment of the commandments in physicality,</t>
    <t s="69">through which they transform the falsehood of the world and connect to His Essence and Being,</t>
    <t s="70">to become literally one roof and floor.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the main dwelling of the Shechinah was in the lower realms, and through the service of making a Sanctuary, specifically from the hard and strong foundation of the boards of Shittim wood, one draws down the self-elevation to the Essence of Ein Sof, culminating in the future redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is "I have come to My garden, My sister, My bride,"</t>
    <t s="2">for the main dwelling of the Shechinah was in the lower realms,</t>
    <t s="3">and the service is "And they shall make for Me a Sanctuary, and I will dwell in their midst,"</t>
    <t s="4">and this is through "boards of Shittim wood, standing," which is the language of pillars that are fixed in the earth,</t>
    <t s="5">that the foundation is specifically in hard and strong earth,</t>
    <t s="6">this is the beginning, and afterwards they are drawn upward until their heads are connected to the ceiling, to the very high,</t>
    <t s="7">as he continues to explain in Iggeret HaKodesh, that they stand in the heights of the levels,</t>
    <t s="8">"the King stands,"</t>
    <t s="9">and it is the drawing down of the self-elevation,</t>
    <t s="10">through the aspect of "am," from the term "omemot" (faintness),</t>
    <t s="11">through which one takes from the self-elevation until the Essence of Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="12">and they draw down through the service of man, that it be "I have come to My garden," to My place of planting, to the place that was My primary place initially, for the main dwelling of the Shechinah was in the lower realms,</t>
    <t s="13">for just as at the beginning of creation it is written,</t>
    <t s="14">"These are the generations" (spelled fully),</t>
    <t s="15">so too in the future redemption it is written,</t>
    <t s="16">"These are the generations of Peretz,"</t>
    <t s="17">"generations" (spelled fully),</t>
    <t s="18">that this will be below ten handbreadths, very close, literally through our righteous Moshiach.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
